notes: 39 HTTP endpoints: 38 new routes under /api/fees/** plus /api/me/fees, and 1 existing route extended (PATCH /api/users/:id gains isBursar). Non-HTTP contracts: maintenance hooks in the existing internal dispatch route, 3 fees.* notification types, the getKpis and parent overview extensions, and the pure fee-math/money functions.
Money is always a 2 dp string and every money payload carries currency. Base path is /api. Envelopes, errors and pagination come from src/server/http.ts.

Error policy: state violations return 409 CONFLICT, the manual reminder throttle returns 429 RATE_LIMITED, a non-bursar write returns 403, an out-of-scope or unknown id returns 404, and an overpayment returns 400 with the exact FR-29 message.

GET /api/fees/invoices returns the filtered totals in meta.totals (FR-18). paginated() is typed with meta { page, pageSize, total }, so pass the meta object through a variable or widen that type. Do not hand-roll the envelope.
Ids with no HTTP surface (covered by system-design instead): FR-1, FR-2, FR-4 (schema), FR-46 (navigation), FR-47, FR-48 (seed), FR-50, FR-51, NFR-10 (tests) and NFR-6 (MUI-only UI).
Open assumption carried from system-design D-12: optional fees are billed on every plan invoice in the year. Confirm with the PRD owner; the change point is buildInvoiceDrafts.
artifacts/architect/threat-model-notes.json (SH-17) is addressed by system-design §3.8. The contracts add Zod bounds on every input and the 404-on-scope policy.
The SH-16 api-contracts.json and handoff were moved to artifacts/architect/.prev-SH-16/.
